title: AI 2: the prioritized view is live

text: AI 2 now opens on four columns by importance: needs you, reports, landed, live (agents, usage bars, the stream). Open any card or 'the full inbox' for the rail view; sub-cards open in a third column; every card has its own event file on Servex. After the merge the page broke in your tab (rows escaping into the site frame) - found by my own screenshot, fixed in one line, proven. Next round: stale stopped agents in the Live column, cost per card, the chain of who touched a card.
